resources.string: Installs RxFilms on your TV in place of Jellyfin. On the TV, turn on Developer options → ADB debugging, and keep this phone on the same Wi-Fi.
No TV found. Check that ADB debugging is on, or type the TV\'s IP address below.
Connecting to %1$s. If the TV asks to allow debugging, choose Always allow.
Removing the original Jellyfin app (its login will be lost)…
Done: RxFilms is installed and opening on the TV.
The latest release (%1$s) has no TV APK.
